text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, write stories, and even compose music. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative? AI can learn from millions of examples and produce something new, but it does not have feelings or personal experiences. Human creativity comes from emotions, imagination, and life itself. Perhaps the best results happen when people and AI work together. Artists can use AI as a helpful tool, but the ideas and meaning behind the work still come from humans.
